The radical [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] used this '''hideout''' on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], during their resurgence under the leadership of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]. Vizsla, the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Concordia, established the Death Watch's base of operations within one of the [[Concordian mines|abandoned mines]] left behind on Concordia from the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|days]] of widespread [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. There, the Death Watch were able to make use of the old mining equipment in the manufacture of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] and weapons for their [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered the Death Watch's hidden base. He was captured and held within the base's attached mining and production facility, before being rescued by [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], leader of Mandalore's [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction. During their escape, Kenobi [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|fought]] against several Death Watch [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] before [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|engaging]] Pre Vizsla in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], a fight the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master took the upper [[Limb/Legends|hand]] in until the entry of a trio of Death Watch troopers. Presented with overwhelming odds, Kenobi and Kryze were forced to retreat, but even after being discovered, the Death Watch continued to operate out of their Concordian base. It was there that Vizsla gathered a Death Watch [[Army/Legends|army]] in preparation for a take over of Mandalore backed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] leader, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. However, when the Count's [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|plan]] fell through, he ordered his Death Watch allies at the base to stand down and await a [[Time/Legends|time]] when their forces would be better prepared to strike.

==Description==
[[File:ConcordianDeathWatchBase.png|thumb|left|250px|Death Watch soldiers with an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]] at their base on Concordia]]
The [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch's]] hidden base on [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]] was located in one of the [[Concordian mines|abandoned mines]] built on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] centuries prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Consisting mainly of a group of curved-roofed buildings, the Death Watch's base sat at the bottom of a circular mining quarry. These buildings were equipped with [[holochart]]s<ref name="TMP" /> and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Comm station/Legends|comm stations]].<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> The Death Watch's numerous [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]]/[[Transport/Legends|transports]]<ref name="EGS1&2">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> could often be found resting on the ground around the main structure.<ref name="TMP" /><ref name="DoM" /> Attached to the above-ground base and accessible by a nearby [[Turbolift/Legends|lift]], was a mining and processing facility, in which the Death Watch used the leftover machinery in the creation of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] for their [[Troop/Legends|troops]].<ref name="TMP" />

==History==
[[File:VizslaTalksWithDooku-TheMandalorePlot.png|thumb|right|250px|Pre Vizsla speaking with Count Dooku inside the Death Watch's base]]
Though Concordia had originally been a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] agricultural settlement, before the end of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] wars, the Mandalorians transformed their moon into a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] base<ref name="TMP" /> in search of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']],<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> a nearly indestructible [[Iron/Legends|iron]] capable of withstanding blows from a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> The extensive mining venture and the numerous mines were eventually abandoned, and over [[Time/Legends|time]], left silently inactive.<ref name="TMP" /> However, in the wake of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Death Watch leader [[Tor Vizsla]] at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons">''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''</ref> the radical and violent Mandalorian splinter group fractured and vanished from the face of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] under the Mandalorian principle of ''ba'slan shev'la'', or "strategic disappearance".<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Tor Vizsla's fellow [[Clan Vizsla/Legends|clansman]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]],<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> rose to become the new leader of the Death Watch as it began to make its return to the galaxy. The younger Vizsla was the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Concordia, and publicly an avid supporter of the peaceful [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction and friend of the New Mandalorians' leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. In truth, Vizsla despised both Kryze and her pacifistic government. In one of the abandoned mines that littered the surface of Concordia, Vizsla secretly established a base where the Death Watch could regroup and operate from, in opposition to the New Mandalorians. There, the Death Watch forces utilized the abandoned industrial equipment left behind by the miners in the process of creating [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and weapons for their [[Gender/Legends|men]].<ref name="TMP" />

While on an investigative mission to Mandalore during the early portion of the Clone Wars—a galaxy-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Separatist forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]—[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] located the Death Watch's base while attempting to ascertain the functioning status of the believed inoperable mines. He was attacked, beaten, and captured by a pair of Death Watch [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Before he could be executed, however, Kenobi was rescued by Duchess Kryze and the two made for the surface, unwittingly walking right into the main area of the Death Watch's base camp. The two ducked behind a pile of rocks for cover, while a number of Death Watchmen opened fire with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and three more attacked the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master from the air with jetpacks. Kenobi defeated the jetpack-equipped [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], as the rest of the Death Watch troops evacuated the area<ref name="TMP" /> aboard their [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]]/[[Transport/Legends|transports]],<ref name="EGS1&2" /> only to be confronted by the Deatch Watch's leader, Pre Vizsla. Vizsla and Kenobi [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|battled]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|Lightsaber duel]] of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]—Vizsla using the [[black]]-bladed [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]] that had been passed down in his clan—and when Vizsla's [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|skills]] proved unable to defeat Kenobi, three of his troops attacked the Jedi Master with jetpack-[[Missile launcher/Legends|launched]] [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. Faced with overwhelming odds, Kenobi fled the base with Kryze.<ref name="TMP" />

[[File:DeathWatchAbandonsConcordiaBase-DoM.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Death Watch army prepares to abandon the Concordian base]]
Despite Kenobi's exposure of the Death Watch's base, the Mandalorian radicals continued to make use of it later [[Galactic Standard Calendar|days]]. It was there that Vizsla assembled a Death Watch [[Army/Legends|army]] in preparation for a masterminded, Separatist-backed takeover of Mandalore in which a Republic [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|occupation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] would allow the Death Watch to appear as liberators of the people. To the Death Watch's displeasure and Pre Vizsla's great anger, the Republic did not send a force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to Mandalore and knowing that the Death Watch did not have the strength to hold the planet for little more than a day against the Mandalorian people's will, Separatist leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] ordered the base's assembled army to stand down until a later time.<ref name="DoM" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Concordian base was no longer the Death Watch's main headquarters. The Death Watch had moved the majority of their operations to a [[Death Watch bunker|new base]], established within a bunker on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world, [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TargetPeacePark.png|thumb|250px|In ''Mando'a'', "TARGET: PEACE PARK" is displayed on the holocharts in the base]]
The Death Watch's hideout on Concordia made its first appearance in the twelfth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], entitled "[[The Mandalore Plot]]." The Concordia base is the second Death Watch installation introduced in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], after the Death Watch bunker on Endor, introduced in the online [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.

During "The Mandalore Plot"'s first scene at the base, a holochart inside can be seen behind Dooku's hologram on which the words "TARGET: [[Peace Park/Legends|PEACE PARK]]" can be seen in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] letters, foreshadowing the destruction of the Peace Park's memorial shrine in the following scene.
